mistakes.text: She put three coats on, so her lashes look huge.
mistakes.normalized: she put three coats on so her lashes look huge
mistakes.feedback_sk: Výsledok je vidieť teraz, preto je lepší Present Perfect: „has put“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Výsledek je vidět teď, proto je lepší Present Perfect: „has put“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The result is visible now, so Present Perfect is better: “has put”.

mistakes.text: She put on three coats, so her lashes look huge.
mistakes.normalized: she put on three coats so her lashes look huge
mistakes.feedback_sk: Výsledok je vidieť teraz, preto je lepší Present Perfect: „has put“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Výsledek je vidět teď, proto je lepší Present Perfect: „has put“.
mistakes.feedback_en: The result is visible now, so Present Perfect is better: “has put”.

mistakes.text: She has been putting three coats on, so her lashes look huge.
mistakes.normalized: she has been putting three coats on so her lashes look huge
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri počte hotových dejov („three coats“) patrí Present Perfect Simple: „has put“, nie „has been putting“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U počtu hotových dějů („three coats“) patří Present Perfect Simple: „has put“, ne „has been putting“.
mistakes.feedback_en: When you count finished actions (“three coats”), use Present Perfect Simple: “has put”, not “has been putting”.

mistakes.text: She has putted three coats on, so her lashes look huge.
mistakes.normalized: she has putted three coats on so her lashes look huge
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Put“ je nepravidelné sloveso: „put – put – put“, teda „has put“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Put“ je nepravidelné sloveso: „put – put – put“, tedy „has put“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Put” is irregular (put – put – put), so “has put”, not “has putted”.

mistakes.text: She has put three coats on, so her lashes look hugely.
mistakes.normalized: she has put three coats on so her lashes look hugely
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „look“ vo význame „vyzerať“ patrí prídavné meno: „look huge“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „look“ ve významu „vypadat“ patří přídavné jméno: „look huge“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “look” meaning “seem”, use an adjective: “look huge”.

mistakes.text: She has put three coats on, so her lashes look like huge.
mistakes.normalized: she has put three coats on so her lashes look like huge
mistakes.feedback_sk: Po „look“ vo význame „vyzerať“ patrí prídavné meno: „look huge“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Po „look“ ve významu „vypadat“ patří přídavné jméno: „look huge“.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “look” meaning “seem”, use an adjective: “look huge”.
